events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Fawlty Towers' to 'Monty Python', his comedic genius is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released in 1968
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their iconic 'White Album' upon the world. A double album packed with diverse tracks, it truly broke the mould. What's your standout track?

events.title: Tribute to Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day. A true showman and an incomparable voice who would have been 80 today. His legend lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released in 1965
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: Rubber Soul
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and showed their incredible evolution. Which track takes you back?

events.title: Tribute to John Lennon, who would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who we lost on this day. His message of peace and incredible music continue to inspire. He would have been 86 today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician and cultural icon David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Birthday
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Forever pushing boundaries and inspiring generations, David Bowie's legacy is as vibrant as ever. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Birthday
angles.copy: All hail the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music, his moves, his undeniable charisma – forever an icon. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Jimmy Page Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and a true guitar innovator. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod Stewart Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! That unmistakable voice has given us decades of hits. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs (Madness) turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Suggs Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us absolute classics for decades. What's your favourite Madness singalong?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer Paul Young, known for his blue-eyed soul hits of the 80s, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Paul Young Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! His smooth vocals gave us some unforgettable 80s anthems. What's your favourite Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Parton Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. A true icon, songwriter, and force of nature. Her music and spirit live on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary Barlow Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his solo hits, his songwriting talent is undeniable. What's your favourite Gary track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Billy Ocean Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! His feel-good hits always bring sunshine to the airwaves. What's your favourite Billy Ocean song?

events.title: First Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony (1989)
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held, honouring rock's pioneering artists.

angles.name: Rock Hall Inaugural
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. A monumental moment for music history, celebrating the legends. Who would be in your Hall of Fame?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark Owen Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From his early Take That days to his solo ventures, he's always had that unique charm. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert (1969)
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Beatles Rooftop
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The ultimate impromptu gig! If you could have seen any band play a rooftop gig, who would it be?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil Collins Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his massive solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable tracks. What's your favourite?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh Grant Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the wonderfully charming Hugh Grant! The quintessential British leading man. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From NSYNC to his solo superstardom, he's a true pop icon. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Veteran English actor Sir David Jason, famous for 'Only Fools and Horses' and 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: David Jason Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Del Boy to Frost, his characters are etched into British television history. What's your favourite David Jason role?

events.title: The Day The Music Died (1959)
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Day Music Died
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. 'The Day The Music Died' remains a poignant moment in music history, but their songs live on.
